paras: Ybor City, just east of downtown [Tampa](/locations/tampa), mixes historic brick buildings, cigar-era casitas and newer lofts and condos. That mix shapes the work our crew sees most.

Older homes need plaster and drywall patches and careful door and hardware repairs. Lofts and condos often need TV mounts set into brick or concrete with the right masonry anchors. Porches and trim need paint that stands up to Florida sun.

Shops and restaurants along 7th Avenue call us for small [commercial repairs](/services/commercial-handyman). Condo and HOA buildings often have their own work rules, so tell us about them when you ask for a quote.
